You’ll lead Identity and Access Management (IAM) initiatives, improve our Okta environment, and help expand Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled workflows across IT. Your work will make secure access simpler and more reliable, helping advance 1Password’s mission to create a safer, simpler digital future for everyone. 

  How we’re using AI today  
 Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security.  • Lead IAM initiatives from concept through rollout, including role-based access control, access reviews, and onboarding and offboarding automation. 
 • Build safeguards that make identity and access changes safer to deploy and easier to audit.
